{{Top}}
An '''acceleration couch''' or '''acceleration chair''' was a piece of technology used in [[Starship/Legends|starships]], especially in [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] and other high-performance vessels. Using [[Acceleration compensator/Legends|acceleration compensators]], the couch would dampen the gravitational forces that affected ships while in voyage.

{{Tech-stub}}
